question: Does a fixed causal-visibility repair transfer across the complete restorable serialization class and fresh model seeds?
discovery: Published E1–E4 evidence; no E5 shifted-layout discovery or fitted repair. Fresh seed list and training recipe were publicly fixed before training.

bootstrap.unit: dictionary row, resampled within each of four query strata
bootstrap.pairing: identical row weights across all layouts, interventions and seeds within each panel; edge panel shares primary weights
bootstrap.primary_aggregation: equal105layout mean; controls equal mean within each of102eligiblelayouts then equal mean acrosslayouts
bootstrap.edge_aggregation: equal six edges; each edge uses only its source-key query stratum, renormalized to unit weight
bootstrap.boundary_aggregation: equal2415layout mean, first256 dictionaries; separately seeded bootstrap is paired within that panel but is not independent new data

numeric_forecast_scope: 72 aggregate forecasts:12endpoints x6seeds. No per-condition numerical prediction claim.
primary_claim: Every validity, per-layout/query recovery, native-deficit and mean-control gate must pass in every seed. Secondary passes cannot rescue a primary failure.
boundary_fixed_key_order_subpanel: Physical K0 K1 K2 K3 followed by every24valueorders:23boundarylayouts plus primary canonicalgrouping reference.
stopping: Evaluate every declared condition on every declared seed once. No outcome-dependent exclusions, new seeds, changed predictions, altered thresholds or repair fitting. Deterministic crash resumption may reuse completed verified shards under the same frozen code and checkpoint identities; it cannot replace saved outcomes.
